texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Arduino® UNO R4 WiFi is the first UNO board to feature a 32-bit microcontroller and an ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi® module (ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8). It features a RA4M1 series microcontroller from Renesas (R7FA4M1AB3CFM#AA0), based on a 48 MHz Arm® Cortex®-M4 microprocessor. The UNO R4 WiFi's memory is larger than its predecessors, with 256 kB flash, 32 kB SRAM and 8 kB of EEPROM.

It features a RA4M1 series microcontroller from Renesas (R7FA4M1AB3CFM#AA0), based on a 48 MHz Arm® Cortex®-M4 microprocessor. The UNO R4 WiFi's memory is larger than its predecessors, with 256 kB flash, 32 kB SRAM and 8 kB of EEPROM.

texts.orig: The UNO R4 WiFi is part of the first UNO series of 32-bit development boards, being previously based on 8-bit AVR microcontrollers. There are thousands of guides, tutorials and books written about the UNO board, where the UNO R4 WiFi continues its legacy.
texts.text: The UNO R4 WiFi is part of the first UNO series of 32-bit development boards, being previously based on 8-bit AVR microcontrollers. There are thousands of guides, tutorials and books written about the UNO board, where the UNO R4 WiFi continues its legacy.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The board features 14 digital I/O ports, 6 analog channels, dedicated pins for I2C, SPI and UART connections. It has a significantly larger memory: 8 times more flash memory (256 kB) and 16 times more SRAM (32 kB). With a 48 MHz clock speed, it is also 3x faster than its predecessors.
texts.text: The board features 14 digital I/O ports, 6 analog channels, dedicated pins for I2C, SPI and UART connections. It has a significantly larger memory: 8 times more flash memory (256 kB) and 16 times more SRAM (32 kB). With a 48 MHz clock speed, it is also 3x faster than its predecessors.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: In addition, it features an ESP32-S3 module for Wi-Fi® & Bluetooth® connectivity, as well as a built-in 12x8 LED matrix, making it one of the most visually unique Arduino boards to date. The LED matrix is fully programmable, where you can load anything from still frames to custom animations.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Arduino® UNO R4 WiFi是首款配备32位微控制器和ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi® 模块 (ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8) 的UNO板。它采用 Renesas的RA4M1系列微控制器(R7FA4M1AB3CFM#AA0)，基于48 MHz Arm® Cortex®-M4 微处理器。UNO R4 WiFi的 内存比前代产品大，有256 kB闪存、32 kB SRAM和8 kB EEPROM。
texts.text: Arduino® UNO R4 WiFi是首款配备32位微控制器和ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi® 模块 (ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8) 的UNO板。它采用 Renesas的RA4M1系列微控制器(R7FA4M1AB3CFM#AA0)，基于48 MHz Arm® Cortex®-M4 微处理器。UNO R4 WiFi的 内存比前代产品大，有256 kB闪存、32 kB SRAM和8 kB EEPROM。

texts.label: text
texts.orig: RA4M1的工作电压固定为5V， ESP32-S3模块为3.3V。这两个MCU之间的通信通过逻辑电平转换器(TXB0108DQSR)执 行。
texts.text: RA4M1的工作电压固定为5V， ESP32-S3模块为3.3V。这两个MCU之间的通信通过逻辑电平转换器(TXB0108DQSR)执 行。

texts.orig: UNO R4 WiFi是第一代32位开发板的一部分, 之前基于8位AVR微控制器。关于UNO开发板有数千篇指南、教程和书籍， UNO R4 WiFi延续了它的传统。
texts.text: UNO R4 WiFi是第一代32位开发板的一部分, 之前基于8位AVR微控制器。关于UNO开发板有数千篇指南、教程和书籍， UNO R4 WiFi延续了它的传统。

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 该开发板具有14个数字I/O端口，6个模拟通道，专用于 I2C、SPI 和 UART 连接的引脚。它具有更大的内存：闪存（256 kB）是之前的8倍，SRAM（32 kB）是之前的16倍。它的时钟速度为48 MHz，比之前的快3倍。
texts.text: 该开发板具有14个数字I/O端口，6个模拟通道，专用于 I2C、SPI 和 UART 连接的引脚。它具有更大的内存：闪存（256 kB）是之前的8倍，SRAM（32 kB）是之前的16倍。它的时钟速度为48 MHz，比之前的快3倍。

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 此外，它还具有ESP32-S3模块，用于Wi-Fi®和Bluetooth®连接，以及内置的 12x8 LED 矩阵，使其成为迄今为止最具视觉 效果的 Arduino 开发板之一 。LED 矩阵是完全可编程的，您可以加载从静态帧到自定义动画的任何内容。
texts.text: 此外，它还具有ESP32-S3模块，用于Wi-Fi®和Bluetooth®连接，以及内置的 12x8 LED 矩阵，使其成为迄今为止最具视觉 效果的 Arduino 开发板之一 。LED 矩阵是完全可编程的，您可以加载从静态帧到自定义动画的任何内容。
